faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Veterinary Assistant Surgeon post in Lakshadweep Administration?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 28th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the administration before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Veterinary Assistant Surgeon role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Veterinary Science & Animal Husbandry (B.V.Sc. & A.H.) and be registered with the relevant Veterinary Council.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned for this recruitment drive by the Lakshadweep Administration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Veterinary Assistant Surgeon position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 50,000/- per month. No additional allowances will be provided.

faq.question: Q5. How will the candidates be selected for the Veterinary Assistant Surgeon post?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will involve a Virtual Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is through email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Veterinary Assistant Surgeon post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Veterinary Assistant Surgeon in the Lakshadweep Administration.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Veterinary Assistant Surgeon position?
faq.answer: This is a contractual engagement for the Veterinary Assistant Surgeon post in the Lakshadweep Administration.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location is Kavaratti, Lakshadweep, with the pincode 682555.

faq.question: Q10. What documents need to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, registration certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
